Generic function for running a pharmpy tool, like bootstrap, or modelsearch. A separate function is available for fit()

call_pharmpy_tool.Rd

Generic function for running a pharmpy tool, like bootstrap, or modelsearch. A separate function is available for fit()

Usage

call_pharmpy_tool(
  id,
  model = NULL,
  results = NULL,
  tool = NULL,
  folder = NULL,
  clean = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  force = FALSE,
  options = list(),
  remove_tables = TRUE
)

Arguments

id

model id. Optional. If not specified, will generate random modelfit id. The id will be used to create the run folder.

model

Pharmpy model object, preferably created using create_model().

results

TODO

tool

TODO

folder

TODO

clean

if one or more run folders exists for the tool, do we want to remove them first?

verbose

verbose output?

force

TODO

options

list of arguments pass on to tool as argument. Documentation for available arguments for each Pharmpy tool can be found here: https://pharmpy.github.io/latest/mfl.html.

remove_tables

if TRUE (default), removes all $TABLE records from the model before passing it to the Pharmpy tool.

Value

fit object

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Run 200 bootstrap samples on a fitted model
bs <- call_pharmpy_tool(
  id      = "run1",
  model   = model,
  results = results,
  tool    = "bootstrap",
  options = list(samples = 200)
)

# Inspect parameter estimates (one row per sample)
head(as.data.frame(bs$parameter_estimates))

# Plot distributions and overlay original estimates
orig <- setNames(results$parameter_estimates$estimates,
                 results$parameter_estimates$parameter)
plot_bootstrap(bs, original_estimates = orig)
} # }
